training.normalization: Training-episode population moments only; float64 accumulation.

subset_metadata.early_definition: Literal episode step < 5; late is step >= 5
subset_metadata.history_scope: Completed transitions within the same cube/task/episode; selection does not remove history rows
subset_metadata.aggregation: Pooled rows and 51 outputs; R2 uses per-feature centered normalized-delta targets
subset_metadata.nonfinite_policy: Any nonfinite included prediction makes its group metric null; counts remain visible
